SYNTHETIC QUESTIONNAIRE SOURCE: SCREEN-OUT TERMINAL
SECTION Eligibility
ITEM T1
Question: Is the respondent at least 15 years old?
Responses: 1 Yes; 2 No.
Routing instruction: If response is 2, SCREEN OUT and end the interview. If response is 1, continue to T2.
ITEM T2
Question: Did the respondent work for pay last week?
ITEM T3
Question: Did the respondent operate a business last week?
